limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Ranked by verified state changes and global transmission: Houthi strikes on Saudi refinery/tower (affects oil, corroborated), US-Iran war posture, new Iran shadow-banking sanctions (authoritative), EU defence readiness, Zelensky grid-strike warning, Rafah evictions, West Bank settler attacks, Russia sabotage campaign.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Central-bank and inflation state changes: PCE accelerated to 3.8% (corroborated hot readings), FOMC minutes, South Korea rate hike, ECB presidency nomination, Argentina money-printing ban, Australia hot CPI, Turkey repo suspension/gold purchase halt, SA producer inflation.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Verified shocks with transmission: NZ hung parliament (market uncertainty, corroborated), Thanksgiving storm power cuts/emergency (corroborated), US shutdown-avoidance deal, Peru M6.7 quake, Mauritius M6.4 quake, Guinea-Bissau election delay, FL disaster declaration, CA/NZ quakes.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Verified central-bank/metals events with market relevance: Turkey suspending domestic gold purchases, India repatriating 60t gold, gold price move (corroborated prints), Indonesia mine flood deaths, $600m China Railway gold deal.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Concrete AI/semiconductor supply-chain state changes: Dutch lobbying against US chip export bill, Nvidia freezing SE Asia orders (chip-stock drag), Schneider liquid-cooling expansion, Skanska $275M data center award, Parsippany data-center ban, Huawei HBM design. Fewer than eight verified non-speculative events exist.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Trade-policy state changes with global transmission: China retaliation to US tariffs on 14 nations, tariff-hike pressure on partners, Bangladesh 18% tariff proposal, Canada vehicle exemption/import drop, Canada canned-vegetable tariffs, India export impacts.
